title: TipsInteractionResult
description: tips.interaction-result@1: one interaction on OpenVibe.Tips (tips.interaction.get, tips.simulation.run). GET /api/v1/interactions/:id → { interaction } in the reader's view (a service, the creator, or the supporter; anyone else 404 tips.interaction_not_found). POST /api/v1/simulate (201) → { interaction }: the simulated interaction (test true, settlement simulated), in the creator's view.
